title: Account security
description: Manage your password, email address, sign-in methods, and active sessions.
actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.empty: There are no active sessions to show.
sessions.signOutDescription: The session on {name} will be signed out immediately.
sessions.signOutAllDescription: You will be signed out on every device, including this one, and must sign in again.
sessions.signedOutAll: All sessions have been signed out.
sessions.geoipProvider: IP location data is provided by {provider}.

password.title: Change password
password.help: Use at least 6 characters. Changing your password signs you out everywhere.
password.changed: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.

mail.title: Email address
mail.help: We will send a confirmation link to the new address. The change takes effect only after you open it.
mail.sentDescription: Open the link we sent to {mail} to finish the change.
mail.confirmedDescription: Your email address has been changed. You can keep using the account as usual.
mail.confirmFailedTitle: Could not confirm the email change
mail.confirmFailedDescription: The link is invalid or has expired, or the address is already in use. Request a new confirmation email from the security page.

authenticators.title: Authenticators
authenticators.description: Use an authentication app or a security key as a second sign-in factor.
authenticators.chooseDescription: Choose the second factor you want to set up.

tfa.name: Authentication app
tfa.short: One-time codes from an authenticator app.
tfa.description: Ask for a six-digit code from your authenticator app when signing in.
tfa.setupDescription: Add the secret to your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
tfa.stepScan: Add the secret below to your authenticator app.
tfa.stepEnter: Enter the current six-digit code from the app.
tfa.codeInvalid: Enter the six-digit code from your app.
tfa.removeDescription: Sign-in will no longer ask for a code from your authentication app.

webauthn.empty: No security keys are registered yet.
webauthn.unsupported: Security keys need a supported browser and a secure connection.
webauthn.platformDescription: Use the fingerprint, face, or screen lock on this device.
webauthn.platformUnavailable: This device does not offer a built-in authenticator.
webauthn.crossPlatformDescription: Use a USB or NFC security key.
webauthn.registrationFailed: Could not add the security key. Try again or use another method.
webauthn.removeDescription: You will no longer be able to sign in with {name}.
webauthn.nameHelp: Give the key a name so you can recognize it later.
webauthn.nameRequired: Enter a name for this key.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: Deletion is scheduled seven days ahead so you can change your mind. You will lose access to this account afterwards.
deletion.confirmDescription: Confirm your password to schedule deletion. The account is removed seven days from now.
deletion.passwordHelp: Your password is used only to confirm this request.
deletion.pendingDescription: Your account will be deleted in seven days. Signing in still works until then.
deletion.pendingCancel: Contact an administrator if you need to cancel the deletion.
